title: December, 2006
logline: Does Chloe come home. An email, again. She's seen the helicopter. Everyone has.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD, still two-thirds size, at the monitor. An email. BARNABY. The chorus, thirty now, filling the back wall like wallpaper.

image.prompt: a small young man at a monitor in a garage whose entire back wall is crowded with tiny stick figures like wallpaper, a dog, an email open on screen, muddy digital flats

panels.composition: The email, Arial: 'W — Seattle for Christmas. Julian's family. (Julian: later.) Also: a helicopter? Wood. A HELICOPTER. Call me. — C.' The strip draws the font. It has stopped hating the font. It's tired.

image.prompt: a panel that is an email window in a plain system font, a short message with one word in capitals
image.notes: Letter after. First mention of Julian, parenthetical, eight years early.

balloons.text: 'Julian: later.' She's got a later now.

image.prompt: a small young man turning from a monitor to a dog with a wounded face

panels.composition: The phone on the garage wall. Wood looking at it. Not calling. The chorus, all thirty, looking at the phone too. The dog asleep. He's two-thirds size and the phone is normal size and that's the strip.

image.prompt: a small young man looking at a normal-sized wall phone in a garage while thirty stick figures on the back wall also look at it, a dog asleep, no words

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: 'Julian: later.' The first Julian. He doesn't call. The chorus watches the phone.
